create_reacher_env: create a Reacher environment with a specified target size and optional config overrides
get_default_config: get the default configuration for the Reacher environment including dt, episode length, and implementation settings
reset_reacher_env: reset the Reacher environment to a random initial state with the target at a random position
step_reacher_env: step the Reacher environment forward with an action and return the new state, observation, and reward
get_reacher_observation: get the observation for the Reacher environment including qpos, finger-to-target delta, and qvel
